acceptance.criterion_verbatim: A FAILED LOAD IS UNREACHABLE TO THE EMPTY-ARRAY ENCODING, at the ROUTE layer. Then the CONTRAST: a SUCCESSFUL call over a range with no data, returning an empty array and NO error key. Print the exact predicate a caller uses to tell them apart. 6 of 6 failure cases plus the honest-empty control, or the criterion FAILS. timeline_api already proved this server-side over constructed rows (HVST-w-3 AC2); this proves the ROUTE does not undo it
